verdict.rationale: Anthropic explicitly frames Skills as an open, cross-platform standard (agentskills.io) and documents installation for Claude Code, the Claude API, and Claude Agent SDK, and community reports (e.g., using Codex with an AGENTS.md pointing to a skill directory) show the same skill folders being reused outside Claude Code. However, there are no first-party, harness-specific install instructions for Cursor or other third-party agents, and community feedback highlights inconsistent skill-triggering across harnesses. Missing for 10: official per-harness setup docs for Cursor/other agents, first-party confirmation of Codex support, and consistent invocation behavior across harnesses.
